name: Boats
description: Delegated USDC trading on Arc: on-chain mandates, first-loss captain capital, inspectable decisions and public settlement.

mcp.moneyUnit: US dollars in tool arguments; USDC base units in calldata and raw reports
mcp.writePolicy: Explicit user intent, correct role, official boat, read current state, dry-run, then simulate. Track every returned transaction hash before retrying.

verification.checks: 8 synthetic cases using the production parser, decision engine and SDK mandate check; not an investment backtest
5 historical Arc receipts, calldata, events, historical mandate rejection and crew payout

claims.claim: Crew principal is senior to captain stake; positive gains are shared pro rata with a fee on crew profit and configurable linear fee vesting
claims.scope: Finite first-loss protection; integer allocation and tested vesting, not a guaranteed loss bound or cross-voyage clawback

claims.claim: A swap exceeding the Bitcoin weight limit reverted
claims.scope: Specific historical testnet transaction; not a security audit

claims.claim: Captain recorded a 91% Gemini signal and reason in a successful swap
claims.scope: Self-reported signal, not a Gemini-signed attestation; no Gemini exchange orders

claims.claim: A completed voyage paid 2.197402 test USDC for 2 USDC crew principal
claims.scope: Controlled mock-price settlement test, not realized investment performance

claims.claim: Bundled captain holds on missing, stale, closed, one-sided or wide-spread signal data
claims.scope: Two-sided spread at most 500 probability bps; fetch age at most 120 seconds does not establish last-trade freshness

prizeTargets.name: DeFi and Onchain Applications
prizeTargets.integration: First-loss vault and full settlement lifecycle

prizeTargets.name: Best use of Arc
prizeTargets.integration: Contracts, USDC deposits, gas and settlement on Arc testnet

prizeTargets.name: Gemini Prediction Markets
prizeTargets.integration: Public market data drives an allocation rule with an on-chain decision memo

limitations: Unaudited testnet code; EURC, USYC and cirBTC are mocks; team controls prices and adapter liquidity
Threshold settlement needs a caller, gas, transaction inclusion, oracle and liquidity; it is not a guaranteed loss bound
Crew cannot currently withdraw from a boat that never sails
The bundled captain uses deterministic rules with no embedded LLM; external LLM agents connect through MCP
Production passkey onboarding was verified interactively in Brave on November 20 after correcting both Circle domains; sponsored boarding remains unverified
Pre-checks and synthetic replay do not establish profitable trading, production safety or legal readiness
